'''Ohali Two''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], created by [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Ohali Soroc]] aboard [[Base Prime]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] nicknamed '''Ditto'''. She was mentally deficient due to imperfections from [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] cloning. Ohali Two was killed by a stray laser bolt when Solo, working with [[Barduun]], made his attempt to escape the Qrephs' clutches.
